text: And he made an altar for whole burnt-offering out of [[2]wood [1]incorruptible]; of five cubits was the length, and five cubits the breadth; [[4]four-cornered [3]was [1]the [2]altar], and [[2]three [3]cubits ; [1]its height].
And he made the horns. Upon the four corners of it were the horns, and he covered them in brass.
And he made a rim on the altar, and the lid for it, and the bowls for it, and the meat hooks for it, and the censer for it; and all the utensils for it he made of brass.
And he made for it [[3]grate [4]work [1]a latticed [2]brass].
And he made for the grate four rings of brass upon the four sides. And he placed them under the grate of the altar from below; and [[3]was [1]the [2]grate] unto half the altar.
And he made the bearing poles for the altar out of [[2]wood [1]incorruptible]; and he brass plated them in brass.
And he inserted the bearing poles at the sides of the altar in the lifting it! [[3]hollow [4]planked [1]He made [2]it].
And he made the [[2]bathing tub ; [1]brass], and the [[2]base [3]of it [1]brass] from out of the mirrors of the women that fasted, who fasted by the doors of the tent of the testimony.
And he made for the courtyard, the one towards the south, shrouds for the courtyard from out of linen being twined -- a hundred by a hundred.
And ; their posts -- twenty, and ; [[4]bases [1]their [2]twenty [3]brass]. And ; their hooks and ; their clips were of silver.
And the side ; towards the north was a hundred by a hundred. And ; their posts -- twenty, and ; [[4]bases [1]their [2]twenty, [3]brass]. And ; their hooks, and ; their clips were of silver.
And the side ; towards the west -- curtains of fifty cubits; their posts -- ten, and ; their bases -- ten, and ; their hooks, and ; their clips were of silver.
And the side ; towards the east -- [[2]of fifty [3]cubits [1]shrouds],
of fifteen cubits ; according to the back, and ; their posts -- three, and ; their bases -- three.
And upon the back of the second on this side and that side according to the gate of the courtyard -- curtains of fifteen cubits, and ; their posts -- three, and ; their bases -- three.
All the curtains for the tent were of linen being twined.

And the bases, the ones of their posts were of brass, and ; their hooks were of of silver, and ; their tips being silver plated in silver; and the posts being silver plated in silver, all the posts of the courtyard.

And the veil of the gate of the courtyard was a work of an embroiderer, of blue, and purple, and scarlet being spun, and linen being twined; twenty cubits was the length, and the height and ; breadth five cubits, being made equal to the shrouds of the courtyard.
And ; their posts -- four; and ; their bases -- four, were of brass; and ; their hooks were of silver, and ; their tips being silver plated in silver.
And all the stanchions of the courtyard round about were of brass.
And this was the arrangement of the tent of the testimony, as was given orders to Moses; the ministration to be of the Levites through Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
And Bezaleel the son; of Uri, of the tribe of Judah, made as the LORD gave orders to Moses,

and Aholiab, the son; of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, who supervised construction -- the woven works, and the stitched works, and the embroideries, woven in the blue and purple, and scarlet being spun, and linen.

All the gold which was manufactured for the works according to all the work of the holies, was of the gold of the first-fruit -- nine and twenty talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, according to the [[2]shekel ; [1]holy].

And of the silver and the choice-portion offering; from the [[2]being numbered [1]men] of the congregation -- a hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred seventy five shekels, [[2]drachma [1]one] ; per head, the half ; shekel, according to the [[2]shekel ; [1]holy],
for every one ; passing into the numbering, from a son twenty years and up, for the sixty ten thousands, and three thousand and five hundred fifty.
And came to pass the hundred talents ; of silver for the molten casting of the tips of the tent, and for the tips of the veil; a hundred tips for the hundred talents, a talent to the tip.
And the thousand seven hundred seventy five shekels he made for the hooks for the posts; and he gilded ; their tips, and adorned them.
And the brass of the choice-portion offering; was three hundred seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
And they made from out of it the bases of the door of the tent of the testimony, and the altar ; of brass with ; its grate, and all the utensils of the altar,
and the bases of the courtyard round about, and the bases of the gate of the courtyard, and the stanchions of the tent, and the stanchions of the courtyard round about.
